duplicate_rule.prose: two findings are approximate duplicates when they carry the same set of failure classes AND the same init_seed AND their scenarios are closer than 0.05 in normalized L-infinity distance over the seven continuous envelope axes (push_heading_deg measured the short way round the circle; push_heading_deg and push_time_s skipped entirely when either side has no push, because they then describe nothing and the two runs are byte-identical); findings from different initial states or different classes are never duplicates of each other

policy.evaluated_by: numpy reimplementation of stable_baselines3.SACPolicy.predict; torch is not a run-time dependency
policy.evaluation: deterministic mean action, tanh-squashed then unscaled to the action box
